text:
What do you think about my secret beach?\c
It’s a small mysterious paradise located on
the very cool ocean.\c
You’ve come all the way here, so I’ll give you
a present.

The move Dive...\c
Your Pokémon won’t be hit by attacks while
it’s diving in the water.\c
That’s right... It may be similar to my beach,
which is so cold that nobody visits.
It certainly is a beach...\nBut it’s just too cold!
